name: train-cs-sk-focal-more-s2
description:
RQ6, a final-model candidate: train-cs-sk-ce-more (CNEC 2.0, UNER Slovak-SNK,
WikiGoldSK and SlavicNER Czech train, every real corpus repeated 3x, 10,000 from each
OpenPII 1M split, held-out text dropped) with gliner's focal loss (alpha 0.75, gamma 2)
of train-cs-sk-focal, which leads on UNER-SK and REDACT among the GLiNER models.
35,051 examples, 2,000 steps of 16. Only the loss differs from train-cs-sk-ce-more.
Trained on MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md).
